auth.checkingSessionDescription: Loading your clinic workspace and role permissions.

errors.invalidCredentialsBody: Check your credentials and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmedBody: Confirm your email address before signing in.

sections.emptyTitle: This workspace section has no records yet
sections.emptyDescription: No fictional sample patients or appointments are preloaded here. Real clinic workflows for this module will be enabled in its dedicated milestone.

schedule.title: Daily schedule
schedule.description: Manage daily appointments, status updates, clinical visit notes, and private WhatsApp reminders.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Review patient records, critical medical alerts highlighted in red, and private clinical attachments.

treatments.title: Treatments catalog
treatments.description: Maintain standard dental procedures, durations, and exact prices in your clinic's currency.

quotes.title: Treatment quotes
quotes.description: Prepare clear treatment plans with exact tax calculations ready to review with patients.

billing.title: Billing & payments
billing.description: Issue invoices, record partial or full payments, and keep a traceable accounting history.

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.description: Configure clinic identity, currency symbol, tax rate, and team preferences.

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.description: Configure your clinic name, billing currency, symbol, tax percentage, timezone, and default language.
settings.readOnlyDescription: Only an Administrator can modify clinic settings. You can review your clinic's active currency and tax configuration below.
settings.auditNotice: Every saved change is automatically recorded in your clinic's immutable audit log.
settings.emptyDescription: No active clinic configuration was found for your current workspace.

presets.title: Regional quick templates
presets.description: Pre-fill standard currency, tax, timezone, and default language values. Changes are only saved when you press Save changes.

form.cardDescription: Treatments, quotes, and invoices across your clinic use these settings for exact cent-level calculations.
form.currencyCodeHint: 3-letter ISO code (for example AED, EUR, USD).
form.currencySymbolHint: Shown next to prices (for example AED, €, $).
form.taxRateHint: Percentage from 0 to 100 (up to 2 decimal places).
form.taxLabelHint: Short tax name shown on quotes and invoices (VAT, IVA, Tax).
form.timezoneHint: Standard IANA timezone used for appointment scheduling.
form.defaultLocaleHint: Default language for clinic documents and new profiles.

feedback.savedDescription: Your clinic configuration is active and has been recorded in the audit log.
feedback.saveErrorDescription: We could not save your changes right now. Your edits are still on screen so you can review and try again.

validation.nameTooLong: Clinic name must be 120 characters or fewer.
validation.currencyCodeInvalid: Enter a valid 3-letter ISO code such as AED, EUR, or USD.
validation.currencySymbolTooLong: Currency symbol must be 10 characters or fewer.
validation.taxRateInvalid: Enter a valid tax percentage between 0 and 100 (up to 2 decimals).
validation.taxLabelRequired: Enter a tax label such as VAT, IVA, or Tax.
validation.taxLabelTooLong: Tax label must be 20 characters or fewer.
validation.timezoneTooLong: Timezone must be 64 characters or fewer.

preview.title: Live format & tax preview
preview.description: Sample calculation for a 100.00 treatment using the configuration on this page.

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Manage synthetic patient profiles, search contact details instantly, and review critical medical alerts highlighted in red.
patients.unconfiguredDescription: Connect the public Supabase environment variables to load and manage clinic patients.

archived.statusHint: Archived — hidden from the schedule and active list
archived.emptyDescription: Patients archived by your clinic will appear here so an administrator can review or restore them.
archived.loadErrorDescription: We could not retrieve archived patient records right now. Please try again.
archived.restoreSuccessDescription: The patient is active again and visible in your clinic's directory.

restoreConfirm.title: Restore this archived patient?
restoreConfirm.description: The patient will return to active lists and an anonymised restore event will be recorded in the audit log.
restoreConfirm.errorDescription: We could not restore this patient right now. Please try again.

search.label: Search patients
search.placeholder: Search by name, phone, or email…

empty.noPatientsDescription: Create your first synthetic patient record to test clinical alerts, appointments, and quotes.
empty.noSearchResultsDescription: No active patient matches your current search by name, phone, or email.

errors.listLoadDescription: We could not load your clinic's patient records right now. Please try again.
errors.detailLoadDescription: We could not retrieve this patient's record due to a connection problem. Please try again.

form.createCardDescription: Register demographic details and highlight any critical allergies before clinical care.
form.editCardDescription: Update contact details, critical medical alerts, or general notes for this patient.
form.syntheticNoticeBody: Never enter real patient names, phone numbers, email addresses, or real medical histories in this validation environment.
form.dateOfBirthHint: Format YYYY-MM-DD (used to calculate age on the chart).
form.medicalAlertsPlaceholder: Penicillin allergy, latex sensitivity, anticoagulant therapy…
form.medicalAlertsHint: Displayed in a high-contrast red alert banner at the very top of the patient's chart.
form.generalNotesPlaceholder: Communication preferences, scheduling notes, or synthetic background…
form.generalNotesHint: General reception and clinical context (up to 2,000 characters).
form.saveErrorDescription: We could not save this patient right now. Your entered information is still on screen so you can try again.

validation.fullNameTooLong: Full name must be 120 characters or fewer.
validation.phoneTooLong: Phone number must be 32 characters or fewer.
validation.emailTooLong: Email address must be 254 characters or fewer.
validation.dateOfBirthTooEarly: Date of birth must be 1900-01-01 or later.
validation.dateOfBirthInFuture: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
validation.medicalAlertsTooLong: Medical alerts must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
validation.generalNotesTooLong: General notes must be 2,000 characters or fewer.

detail.loadingDescription: Retrieving demographic information and medical alerts.
detail.notFoundDescription: This patient chart does not exist, belongs to another clinic, or has been archived.
detail.medicalAlertBannerHint: Verify allergies and clinical precautions before starting any dental procedure.
detail.noMedicalAlertsDescription: No critical allergies or medical alerts are registered for this patient.
detail.savedBannerDescription: Your changes to this patient record have been saved.
detail.noGeneralNotes: No general notes recorded for this patient.
detail.archiveConfirmDescription: The patient will be hidden from active clinic lists without deleting historical records, and an anonymised archive event will be recorded in the audit log.
detail.archiveErrorDescription: We could not archive this patient right now. Please try again.

files.title: Photos & synthetic X-rays
files.description: Attach and review private intraoral photos, synthetic X-rays, and PDF reports using temporary signed links.
files.syntheticNoticeBody: Upload fictional sample images or synthetic PDFs only. Never upload real patient photographs or X-rays in this test environment.
files.uploadHint: Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF · Maximum size: 10 MB.
files.uploadSuccessDescription: Stored in your clinic's private bucket and accessible only via temporary signed URLs.
files.loadingDescription: Retrieving this patient's private photos and synthetic X-rays.
files.emptyTitle: No synthetic photos or X-rays yet
files.emptyDescription: Upload a synthetic intraoral image or PDF report above to test private clinical storage.
files.unconfiguredDescription: Connect the public Supabase environment variables to upload and review private clinical files.

errors.listLoadDescription: We could not retrieve this patient's private attachments right now. Please try again.
errors.uploadFailedDescription: The file could not be stored in private storage right now. Please try again.
errors.signedUrlFailed: Temporary link unavailable or expired. Refresh the link to view.
errors.archiveFailedDescription: We could not archive this file right now. Please try again.

validation.unsupportedMimeType: Unsupported file type. Upload a JPG, PNG, WEBP image or a PDF document.
validation.fileEmpty: The selected file is empty. Choose a valid file to upload.
validation.fileTooLarge: File exceeds the 10 MB maximum size limit.
validation.fileNameInvalid: Invalid file name. Rename the file (up to 255 characters) and try again.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this clinical file?
archiveConfirm.description: The file will be hidden from the patient's chart, access to new signed links will be revoked immediately, and an anonymised event will be recorded in the audit log.

optimization.preserveOriginalHint: Large images (> 1 MB) are automatically optimized to save space. PDFs are never modified.

replace.successDescription: The new file was uploaded safely and the previous version was archived.
replace.errorDescription: The replacement upload failed, so the previous file was kept intact. Please try again.
replace.archivePreviousErrorDescription: The new file was uploaded, but the previous version could not be archived automatically. You can archive it manually.

selfPurge.successDescription: The mistaken file was removed from storage to free up space and recorded in the audit log.
selfPurge.confirmDescription: Deletes this recently uploaded file and frees up storage space. This cannot be undone.
selfPurge.errorDescription: The 15-minute correction window may have expired or a connection error occurred. You can archive it instead.

archived.emptyDescription: Archived photos and synthetic X-rays for this patient will appear here so an administrator can restore them or free up storage space.
archived.loadErrorDescription: We could not retrieve archived clinical files right now. Please try again.
archived.restoreSuccessDescription: The file is active again on this patient's chart.

restoreConfirm.title: Restore this clinical file?
restoreConfirm.description: The file will become visible again in active clinical attachments and an anonymised restore event will be recorded in the audit log.
restoreConfirm.errorDescription: We could not restore this file right now. Please try again.

archived.purgeSuccessDescription: The file was removed from storage to free up space while preserving the anonymised audit record.

purgeConfirm.title: Permanently delete from storage?
purgeConfirm.description: Deletes the file from storage to free up space. This action cannot be undone.
purgeConfirm.errorDescription: The storage file could not be removed right now. Please try again.
